title: Gospel Presenter
tagline: Delightfully simple presentation software for churches. Free and open-source.
feature_presentations_desc: Build presentations with songs, Bible passages, and images.
feature_liveDisplay_desc: Show your presentation fullscreen on a second screen. Changes sync instantly to all connected viewers.
feature_songLibrary_desc: Manage your church's song collection with lyrics, metadata, and version history. Import songs from ProPresenter.
feature_bible_desc: Browse and search multiple Bible translations. Add verses directly into your presentations.
feature_overlays_desc: Display text or images on top of your slides — perfect for announcements, QR codes, or collection info.
feature_multiUser_desc: Invite team members and manage roles. Each organization has its own song library and presentations.
feature_darkMode_desc: A clean, modern interface with full dark mode support that works on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
feature_openSource_desc: Completely free and open source. Self-host on your own server.
about1: Gospel Presenter is a free and open-source presentation app built for churches. It makes it easy to display song lyrics and Bible verses on a second screen during services.
about2: The project is open source. Visit the GitHub repository for instructions on how to self-host.
